disposition_reason: Mercury, cadmium, lead and arsenic were measured in pooled muscle of shi drum and brown meagre bought in Apulian fish markets.

study.design: market survey of two demersal fish species with dietary risk assessment
study.market: fish markets of the Apulian region, south Italy
study.method: Cd and Pb by graphite furnace AAS after HNO3-HClO4 digestion; Hg and As by hydride vapor generation AAS after H2SO4-HNO3 digestion (Shimadzu AA 7000)
study.lod_text: LOD Hg 5, Cd 0.12, Pb 10, As 6 ng/g w.w.; LOQ Hg 13, Cd 0.40, Pb 0.38, As 18 ng/g w.w. (Pb LOQ printed below its LOD)
study.qa: TORT-2 lobster hepatopancreas CRM, recoveries 92-104%; spike recoveries 96-99%; duplicate analyses, RSD <10%; blanks below detection

regulatory_or_exposure.what: MPLs used: Hg 0.50, Cd 0.05, Pb 0.30 µg/g w.w. (EU); As 1.0 and 2.0 µg/g (other references)
regulatory_or_exposure.value: Cd averages 0.07 and 0.10 µg/g exceed the 0.05 limit

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Estimated weekly/monthly intakes, THQ, ILCR for general population and high-level fish consumers

unresolved: Table 1 header prints the unit as mg g−1 w.w. while Methods 2.3 and the abstract state µg g−1 w.w.; values recorded as µg/g.
Printed Pb LOQ (0.38 ng/g) is lower than its LOD (10 ng/g).
Length ranges in Table 1 (28.5–38.4 cm; 20.5–26.4 cm) differ from Methods 2.1 (28.7–35.5 cm; 22.7–26.0 cm).
Inorganic arsenic and methylmercury are assumed as 10% of total As and 100% of total Hg for risk assessment; not recorded as measured species.
Not a bivalve: this paper does not measure clams or any shellfish.
